title: Chrome extension builder
description: Builds the Angular application and bundles the extension scripts. All options of the '@angular/build:application' builder are also accepted.

backgroundScript.description: Path to the background script, relative to the workspace root (e.g. src/background.ts). The output file is 'background.js'.

contentScript.description: Path to the content script, relative to the workspace root (e.g. src/content.ts). The output file is 'content.js'.

manifest.description: Path to the manifest, relative to the workspace root (e.g. src/manifest.json).

base.description: Specify the output path relative to workspace root.

browser.description: The output directory name of your browser build within the output path base. Defaults to 'browser'.

server.description: Passed to the Angular application builder. Not used by the extension scripts.

media.description: Passed to the Angular application builder. Not used by the extension scripts.
